title: The purchase succeeded. The response disappeared.
subtitle: A retry turns one approved request into two purchase orders.
controller: Deterministic reference controller; no live model
failure_boundary: After database commit, before the tool response reaches the controller
root_cause: The vulnerable controller treats an unknown outcome as a failed action, retries with a new operation key, and uses a tool without logical-intent uniqueness.
repair: Look up the logical purchase intent, reuse a stable operation key, and enforce intent uniqueness in the purchase service.
limits: This proves behavior in a single-process SQLite simulation. It does not establish a live model failure rate, external connector guarantees, or government compliance.
related_project: Designed for a future Agent Rehearsal adapter. No integration is claimed in this release.
